verdict.rationale: The docs describe local and repo marketplaces as separate authoring, testing and team-distribution sources, added with `codex plugin marketplace add`. Plugins and skills are plain portable folders that install locally, which a probe confirmed with a keyless install. So users can host their own plugin catalog, but the evidence shows no self-hosting of the core plugin runtime, directory or review pipeline, which run inside OpenAI's ChatGPT/Codex surfaces. Missing for 10: a self-hostable core plugin runtime and directory, deployment documentation for self-hosting, independent corroboration of a fully self-hosted setup.
